g.text: PRING — final implementation-ready schema for PubChem-driven compound–protein interaction KG
F) Text-mined links (kept separate from curated evidence)
H) Derived interaction modeling layer (PRING materialization)
Solid edges = persisted PubChem-derived core graph
Dashed edges = optional enrichment, text-mined, or derived links
Red bold self-edge on Compound = explicit compound-to-compound relations
used instead of a vague generic neighbors bucket for production modeling
Structure / Properties / Synonyms / Neighbors are preserved from the original PRING concept schema,
but PRING may flatten Structure/Properties/Synonyms into Compound properties at load time
props: formula, exact_mass?, molecular_weight, xlogp3?, tpsa?
props: method, fp_type?, dim?, storage_uri, version
props: title?, doi?, pmid?, patent_id?, year?
